summary: Structured calendar scaffold for assessor operations, aggregating PAD calendars, assessment date, roll revision, notices, protests, statewide equalization, certification, levy, homestead, personal property, and education calendar domains.
plain_language: This is the calendar spine; the next pass should parse every PAD calendar PDF into date-specific objects.

dates.label: January 15 to March 1
dates.meaning: Preliminary valuation meeting opportunity in counties meeting statutory population threshold.

dates.label: January 1 to March 19/March 25
dates.meaning: Assessment roll update/revision window; March 25 date applies to counties meeting statutory population threshold.

dates.label: early April to May 15
dates.meaning: TERC statewide equalization authority window described by DOR FAQ.

dates.label: June 1
dates.meaning: Real property valuation change notice deadline context.

dates.label: June 1 to June 30
dates.meaning: Regular real property valuation protest filing period.

dates.label: August 10
dates.meaning: Centrally assessed railroad/public service equalization certification context in DOR FAQ.

dates.label: August 20
dates.meaning: County assessor total taxable value certification to local governments for rate setting.

relationships.note: Reporting due dates require section-level extraction.
